title: add-benchmark-lab-reporting-pipeline-v57
author: Maya Patel
description: Add Benchmark Lab reporting pipeline v57: introduces multi-variant aggregations, histogram-backed latency buckets, and incremental upload support for representative workload runners. Motivation: improve accuracy of cross-run comparisons when workloads vary in sequence length and model variant, reduce S3 egress by incremental diffs, and provide stable histograms for latency P95/P99 tracking as part of our profiling baselines. This PR wires the new pipeline into the existing benchmark-lab DAG, adds a lightweight transform to normalize run metadata, and extends the reporting schema to include variant tags, quantization profile metadata, and batch-size dimensions. Included in scope: - DAG: benchmark_lab/reporting_v57.py with multi-variant aggregation steps and incremental upload tasks. - Transforms: reporters/normalize_run_metadata.py and reporters/histogram_buckets.py. - Schema: reporting/schemas/v57.json and compatibility layer in reporting/compat.py to map older runs. - Tests: unit tests for histogram bucketing and end-to-end integration test using local runner and a small S3 stub. - CI: new smoke test that runs the pipeline headless on a sampled run and asserts no regressions vs v56. Rollout plan: staged rollout behind a feature flag controlled by Benchmark Lab console; initial sampling to 10% of runs for 48h, then full rollout. Backwards compatibility: older reports remain readable via compat mapper; consumers of v56 schema should transition to v57 fields but will continue to receive mapped outputs. Checklist: [x] DAG implemented [x] transforms added [x] unit tests [x] integration test [x] smoke CI [x] documentation updated in benchmark-lab/README.md See related Linear tasks ENG-2114 (multi-variant reporting), ENG-2189 (incremental uploads).
commits: Initialize v57 DAG and add orchestration tasks
Implement histogram_buckets utility and unit tests
Extend reporting schema v57 and add compatibility mapper
Add integration smoke test and CI job
Docs: update benchmark-lab README and rollout notes
review_comments: Ethan Wong: Nice work overall, two minor nits: 1) can we avoid materializing the full run payload when calculating histograms? 2) please add a short explanation of variant tagging in the README.
Maya Patel: Thanks Ethan, addressed by streaming histogram windows to avoid large memory use and added README section describing variant tagging and how it maps to model/quantization fields.
Priya Shah: CI flakes on the integration test in the first run looked like a race on S3 eventual consistency; please add retry/backoff for the uploader.
Maya Patel: Added exponential backoff with idempotent upload retry; re-ran CI and all checks passed.
Diego Ramos: Left an inline comment about schema naming (v57 vs v57-alpha). Prefer keeping stable name if we're ready to merge.
Maya Patel: Kept v57 stable name per Diego's suggestion after confirming backwards compatibility mapper behavior.
release_notes: Adds benchmark-lab reporting pipeline v57 with multi-variant aggregations, histogram-backed latency buckets, and incremental upload support. Backwards compatible via reporting compatibility mapper.
notes: Staged rollout behind feature flag; monitor P95/P99 histograms and S3 upload error rates during initial 48h 10% sampling.
